resources.string: Before you start, we want you to know exactly how TSPodcast handles information, and to let you decide for yourself.
Your name, email, phone number, contacts, precise location or device identifier (ANDROID_ID). You don\'t need to create an account.
Favourite topics, favourites list, listening history and position, settings. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data deletes all of it.

The screens you open, the features you use, the app and operating system versions, sent to Google Firebase Analytics. Purpose: to learn which features are useful so we can improve the app. Not linked to your name or phone number.
When the app runs into an error: error details, device model, Android version and a random installation ID, sent to Google Firebase Crashlytics. Purpose: to find and fix bugs faster.
You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings, and ask to see or delete your data via the support email. If you don\'t consent, you can still use every feature.
By tapping either button, you confirm you have read the information above. Your choice applies only to the purposes stated.
What do you like to listen to?
Pick at least 3 topics so TSPodcast can suggest shows that suit your taste.
